paper.abstract_en: We prove the black hole uniqueness conjecture in the axially symmetric, stationary, electrovacuum setting, subject to the refined asymptotic analysis of the associated singular harmonic maps, which includes an analyticity hypothesis at the axes. More precisely, it is shown that any asymptotically flat solution of the Einstein--Maxwell equations in this class, with more than one black hole horizon component is either: Majumdar--Papapetrou, up to a duality rotation, in which case all logarithmic angle defects vanish, or every finite axis rod logarithmic angle defect is strictly negative and hence every interaction force is strictly attractive. The proof extends the singular harmonic map method used for vacuum Kerr uniqueness in [18].

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在轴对称稳态电真空情形下研究黑洞唯一性猜想，直接关涉广义相对论基础问题，并延伸使用奇异调和映射方法，理论深度较高，方法上给出了明确的假设与结论结构，值得进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明了在轴对称、稳态、电真空情形下的黑洞唯一性猜想，该证明依赖于对相关奇异调和映射的精化渐近分析，其中包含轴上的解析性假设。更确切地说，本文表明，在此类中，Einstein--Maxwell 方程的任意渐近平坦解，若具有多于一个黑洞视界分量，则要么是 Majumdar--Papapetrou 解，至多相差一个对偶旋转，在此情形下所有对数角缺陷消失；要么每个有限轴杆对数角缺陷严格为负，从而每个相互作用力都严格为吸引力。该证明扩展了 [18] 中用于真空 Kerr 唯一性的奇异调和映射方法。
